description: Pump TradeEvent payloads emitted on Solana mainnet-beta by program 6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P, retained byte-for-byte from finalized transactions.

source.selection: Every third successful signature from getSignaturesForAddress(6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P, commitment finalized) pages ending at the earliest listed slot; buy, sell, buy_exact_sol_in and buy_exact_quote_in TradeEvents kept. Retained: every event on a non-SOL quote curve, with nonzero holder_rewards_bps, or from buy_exact_sol_in/buy_exact_quote_in, plus the 150 earliest remaining events by (slot, signature, eventIndex).
source.field: data is the base64 text after 'Program data: ' in meta.logMessages; eventIndex counts TradeEvent payloads within the transaction's logs.
